answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the lantern is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
